name: Coherence
description: Measures how logically consistent and connected the response is to the preceding conversation.

name: Relevance
description: Assesses how pertinent the response is to the topic being discussed in the conversation.

name: Engagement Level
description: Evaluates how engaging and interesting the response is, including its ability to encourage further conversation.

name: Creativity
description: Measures the originality and inventiveness of the response, particularly in introducing new ideas or perspectives.

name: Contextual Awareness
description: Assesses the respondent's understanding and incorporation of the context and facts provided in the conversation.

name: Emotional Resonance
description: Evaluates the ability of the response to connect on an emotional level, fostering empathy or shared feelings.
